In L3: the outer cells are R (red). The legend has R and O. The minis have markers O (top, bottom) and R (left, right). Hmm! So there are two marker colors. The outer cells are currently all R.
What's the "other" color for the outer cells? The legend shows R (top) and O (bottom). In L2 the legend showed b and O, and the outer cells were b/O. In L1 the legend showed b and R, and the outer cells were b/R.
So in L3 the outer cells can be R or O (toggle). The minis use W, g, c as pattern colors and O or R as markers.
Mapping hypothesis (from L1/L2): W→marker color, g→other color, c/background→wildcard.
But which marker color does each mini use? The top mini's marker is O, the left/right minis' markers are R, the bottom mini's marker is O.
